notes.title: Check out Astro Protocol — a turn-based space strategy game
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone!

Things are moving forward for Ephemeris and we are hoping to share more good news in the near future. While you wait, here’s another promising title to keep on your radar.

Our friends at Null Vector Studios, a new Finnish indie team like us, are developing Astro Protocol — a turn-based space strategy game with 4X elements, designed to be played in a single session.

If you’re into colonizing planets, building fleets, and tactical space battles, be sure to check it out and wishlist Astro Protocol on Steam!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3727420/Astro_Protocol/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Behind the scenes video
notes.notes:
Who is behind Ephemeris and why was it created? Which games did Tuomas, our "more or less Lead Everything" play growing up?

We have published a new YouTube video that tells you a bit more about the concepts behind our game project. Go check it out! May contain traces of doggos.

Remember to spread the word of the [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/ephemeris-4x-space-strategy-with-true-3d-combat/x/38111662#/]crowdfunding campaign [/url]even further and also check out our other videos about Ephemeris in our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@yrdvaab/videos]channel[/url]!

All the best from everyone at YrdVaab!
